parameters.content:
## $0 by design — same copy/paste pattern as Phase 1-2, 5

No Anthropic API key here either. Pauses on a form showing you the Thumbnail
Agent's exact system prompt (Agent #8 in 03-AGENT-PROMPTS.md) — copy it into
your own Claude.ai / Claude Code chat, then paste the JSON back.

## Known simplifications (honest, not hidden)

- **"Video title"** input to the prompt is the Topic Title, not a real
  SEO-optimized YouTube title — there's no Publishing/SEO Agent (#10) run
  yet in this build to produce one. Revisit once that phase exists.
- **"Recent performance notes"** is always "No analytics history yet" —
  this is every channel's first video, `analytics_snapshots` is empty.
- **No actual thumbnail images are generated.** Adobe Firefly Services
  isn't connected (same limitation as Phase 3's `ai_image` assets), so this
  only produces and stores the 3 text CONCEPTS (visual description + text
  overlay + reasoning), not rendered image files. `thumbnails.storage_url`
  is left null on all 3 rows.
- `thumbnails` has no dedicated "concept description" column — the concept
  text is packed into `variant_label` (e.g. `A — curiosity/question: ...`)
  since that's the only free-text column the schema offers. Worth adding a
  real `concept_text` column later.

## Before running this

1. Requires a video at `videos.stage = 'qc_passed'` (Phase 5 must have
   passed for this topic first).
2. Reuses the **Supabase account** credential — wire it into every HTTP
   node that hits `/rest/v1/...`.
3. Activate, open the Form Trigger's Production URL, enter the exact Topic
   Title.
4. On completion: 3 rows inserted into `thumbnails` (recommended concept
   marked `selected: true`), `videos.stage` set to `thumbnail_ready`.
